scope: Official route and GPX status audit for ten records in the historic/original top-level event list 69–78; this is not the current event-dates.json insertion range 69–78.
rules: Old GPX files remain valid until a replacement is officially published, downloaded, parsed and validated.
Do not delete or replace historical GPX files during this audit.
Official download buttons/Map + GPX sections are not proof that binary data has been parsed.
